newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iranian vice-president flies to Syria.
newsitem.headline: Iranian vice-president flies to Syria.

text.p: Iranian Vice-President Hassan Habibi flew to Syria on Saturday for talks on Turkey's military campaign in northern Iraq and developments in the Middle East peace process.

Tehran's official news agency IRNA said Habibi would head Iran's team at talks by a joint higher cooperation committee that would discuss Turkey's incursion into Iraq and "review further cooperation among Islamic countries to counter increasing conspiracies by the Zionist regime (Israel)".
Habibi is due to "also hold talks with several leading Lebanese and Palestinian officials", IRNA said without giving any details.
